licence_restriction: NON-COMMERCIAL. Research use only. Nothing trained on MSPB may ship in a commercial deployment without the authors' permission.
feature_design: Monthly means of 7 derived signals (low/mid/high band energy, high-low ratio, temperature, humidity, audio density), each summarised as mean, sd, last value, range and seasonal slope.

notes.varroa: Modelled as CLASSIFICATION because the count is zero-inflated: 36 of 53 colonies measured exactly zero, median 0.0, max 2.74. Regression on that target mostly rewards predicting the mean. Features use only months before the measurement date.

evaluation: Leave-one-COLONY-out (n=53). The unit is the colony, not the sensor row, because rows from one colony are repeated measurements of the same thing.
changes_from_0_1_0: v0.1.0 used one season average per colony and found nothing. It also leaked (the average spanned months after the varroa count) and modelled a zero-inflated count as regression. v0.2.0 uses time-resolved monthly features, restricts varroa features to months before the measurement, and models varroa as binary detection scored by AUC.
caveat: Apis mellifera in Quebec, n=53 colonies. At this sample size both a positive and a negative result are weak evidence, and no amount of feature engineering changes that. Reported as measured.
